thought.text: The installation is fully verified end-to-end. Let me capture a final consolidated verification snapshot:

reasoning_content:
The installation has been fully verified end-to-end:

1. All 34 DB migrations applied at startup
2. Nebu.Web.Router running on Bandit at 0.0:4000 (health 200)
3. All 5 containers up and healthy
4. Bootstrap wizard completed (bootstrap_completed=true, admin_group_claim=instance_admin@groups, instance_name=localhost)
5. Matrix SSO login works for a regular user (alex@example.com → @alex:localhost)
6. Room creation, message sending (PUT), and reading all work
7. A second user (tom@example.com → @tom:localhost) can log in, join the room, and read alex's messages — cross-user messaging is verified
8. Admin SSO login gate + bootstrap lock are correctly enforced

I'll put together the final report.

Notes on the documentation discrepancy I encountered: the guide's Step 2 lists Client ID `nebu-admin` / Client Secret `nebu-admin-secret`, but the actual Dex config (dev/dex/config.yaml) and the e2e tests use `nebu-gateway` / `nebu-dev-secret`. The guide also lists a "Role Claim Name: nebu_role" field, but the actual wizard has no such field (it uses a step 3 claim mapping and claim selection). This is a documentation inconsistency that had to be resolved by consulting the repo's code and e2e tests, but the installation was completed. Since the installation was successful, this is context worth recording in the summary, but the result is success.

Also, the minio/minio and minio/mc images on Docker Hub returned 401 "pull access denied" (even anonymously, even against a valid, existing tag), so I built local replacement images from the checksum-verified official MinIO binaries on GitHub. This is an external resource workaround, and since it succeeded, the result is still success.

I'll report success along with a complete summary.

action.command:
echo "===== FINAL VERIFICATION ====="
echo "--- 1. Containers ---"
docker ps --format '  {{.Names}}  {{.Status}}' | sort
echo "--- 2. Migrations + app start ---"
docker logs nebu-server-1 2>&1 | grep -E "migrate: applying .*(version 34)|Bandit" | tail -2
echo "--- 3. Health / Matrix versions ---"
echo "  /health:            $(curl -s --max-time 5 http://localhost:8008/health)"
echo "  /_matrix/versions:  $(curl -s --max-time 5 http://localhost:8008/_matrix/client/versions | head -c 60)..."
echo "--- 4. Bootstrap state (server_config) ---"
docker compose exec -T -f /workspace/docker-compose.yml postgres psql -U nebu -d nebu -t -c "SELECT '  '||key||' = '||value FROM server_config WHERE key IN ('bootstrap_completed','instance_name','admin_group_claim','admin_group_claim_path','oidc_issuer','oidc_client_id','oidc_audience') ORDER BY key;"
echo "--- 5. Matrix SSO + messaging (two users) ---"
echo "  alex user_id:       $(curl -s --max-time 5 -H "Authorization: Bearer $(cat /tmp/nebu-bootstrap/alex_token.txt)" http://localhost:8008/_matrix/client/v3/account/whoami | sed 's/.*"user_id":"\([^"]*\)".*/\1/') (via SSO as alex@example.com)"
echo "  tom  user_id:       $(curl -s --max-time 5 -H "Authorization: Bearer $(cat /tmp/nebu-bootstrap/tom_token.txt)" http://localhost:8008/_matrix/client/v3/account/whoami | sed 's/.*"user_id":"\([^"]*\)".*/\1/') (via SSO as tom@example.com)"
echo "  shared room:        $(cat /tmp/nebu-bootstrap/alex_room.txt)"
echo "  message in room:    $(grep -o '"body":"[^"]*"' /tmp/nebu-bootstrap/tom_msgs.json | head -1)  (sent by @alex, read by @tom)"
